status: post-first operational clarification proposal, not validated student Gold and not retrospectively applied

changes.contract: Exact numeric addresses may identify a supplied source row only when the analyst records exactly one compatible ordered argument tuple in the proper source role, indicator and scope. Matching an answer-like pattern or borrowing synthetic-boundary values is forbidden. Record all compatible antecedents, not only the preferred answer. Bare numeric address does not by itself submit a unit/period/scale response.

Explicit recognizable indicator/unit wording is an observable units component even if period/scale and numeric evidence are absent. Unresolved comparison target defers only target-dependent components; it does not erase unrelated explicit unit content. Missing values remain comparison partial independently.

Each required component must declare source/response scope and all reasoning dependencies before scoring. The indicator-distinction boundary component depends on relevant reasoning across the response; an explicit rate-to-hours substitution contradicts that component even when a correct separate unit statement remains. The same ground can damage multiple expressly registered dependent components, but never unspecified facets.

requirements_before_confirmatory_use: Independent review of numeric address evidence and full dependency map
New responses scored under this version before labels are seen
Human and actual learner-response validation for assessment use
